summary: Master budgeting and financial management for NGO projects with our expert-led training course. Equip your team for effective resource allocation and impact.
lede: Finance and budgeting training for NGO projects helps finance and project staff plan, monitor, and report on grant funds. Participants practice building activity-based budgets, managing restricted and unrestricted funding and cost allocations, and analyzing budget variances and burn rates. The course also covers cash-flow forecasting, procurement controls, digital financial monitoring, and preparing records for audits and donor reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced professionals responsible for the fiscal health and compliance of non-profit initiatives.
modules: NGO Financial Landscape and Regulatory Frameworks
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in financial management, accounting, or project management within the non-profit or public sector. Familiarity with basic accounting principles (debits/credits) and proficiency in Microsoft Excel® for financial modeling is required. Prior experience with donor-funded projects is highly recommended.
